sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: A Nidhi Company mainly deals in lending loans and managing deposits of its members. Nidhi Companies in India have many exemptions in taxes and regulatory compliances that is why it is most preferred structure for managing community funds. It is formed to provide the benefits of its members. Nidhi Company registration process in India is governed by Section 406 of the Companies Act, 2013, the Companies (Nidhi Companies) Rules of 2014, and Chapter XXVI of the Companies Rules, 2014.
Here are the benefits of registration of the Nidhi Company

Not Required RBI Approval: NIDHI Company need not to get RBI clearance to start operations. Although it comes within the category of NBFC. NIDHI Companies are registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs as a Public Limited Company. After Nidhi Company registration, you need to comply with the Companies Rules of 2014 and the Companies Act of 2013. With respect to the RBI rules, they are exempted from many regulations. These are the reasons people in India prefer registering a NIDHI company.

Less Capital Requirement: You need not to have hefty amount for a NIDHI Company registration in India. Nidhi Company registration online is cost-efficient to register a NIDHI Company as compared to a NBFC. You need to have an amount of Rs. 10, 00,000 lakhs to register a NIDHI Company.
Separate Legal Entity: Nidhi Company enjoy the status of a distinct legal entity from its members or shareholders.

Perpetual Succession: Company’s existence is remain intact irrespective of any change in its management. Even the death or insolvency of its shareholders does not have any effect on the very existence of the Nidhi Company registration.
Limited Liability of Members: The liability of members of a NIDHI Company is limited to the amount of their share capital in the company.

Minimum Risk of Non-Repayment of Loan: Nidhi Company only lends money to its members and manages deposits of them, it lowers the risk of loan non-repayment, which is not the case for Non-Banking Finance Companies. There will be no external interference in the operation of the NIDHI Company since all financial transactions in a NIDHI Company are limited to its members only.
Below is the list of some essential documents for registration
Proof of the registered office of the company (Ownership documents/ rent or lease agreement)
No Objection Certificate signed by the owner, in case of rented property
Identity proof of the members
Address proof of the members
Passport size Photos of the members
PAN cards of the members are also required for Nidhi company registration
